description: This file defines data schemas for the API endpoints of a media subtitle synchronizer backend, using Pydantic models to structure responses and data items related to uploaded media files and their processing status. It specifies response models for upload acknowledgment, status tracking, and listing of files, with descriptive fields and type annotations.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response model for the upload endpoint, containing media ID, filename, status, message, and theme.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Processing status information for a media item, including timestamps, error message, and theme.

classes.name: FileItem
classes.description: Represents a single uploaded file with its status and timestamps.

classes.name: FilesListResponse
classes.description: Response model for listing multiple uploaded files with total count.
